verdict.rationale: Only a single older community comment claims PlanetScale databases 'scale to 0' and can 'scale to support massive load,' suggesting some automatic elasticity, but no current first-party documentation confirms automatic compute autoscaling without manual resizing—capacity changes described in the docs (VTTablet size adjustments, sharding, Metal tiers) are explicitly manual operations. missing for 10: dedicated autoscaling documentation, evidence of zero-downtime automatic vertical/horizontal compute scaling, and independent confirmation of no manual intervention needed.
